Name: Percy Warner Park
Description: Percy Warner Park is one of my favorite places to go on long walks with friends, my family, and my dog. The trails are beautiful and peaceful, and it's the perfect place to get outside and reset.

Name: Neighbors Bar Sylvan Park
Description: Neighbors in Sylvan Park is my friend group's go-to spot whenever we are all home in Nashville. It's super casual, always lively, and the kind of place where we can sit for hours catching up.

Name: Nissan Stadium
Description: Nissan Stadium is where I go to watch Tennessee Titans games, which is always such a fun experience. The energy of the crowd and being downtown with thousands of fans makes game days really special.

Name: Ryman Auditorium
Description: The Ryman Auditorium is my favorite concert venue in Nashville. The history and acoustics make every show feel intimate and special, and it really represents the heart of Nashville's music scene.

Name: Bluebird Cafe
Description: The Bluebird Cafe is such a special place for authentic Nashville songwriting and live music. The shows are small and intimate, which makes hearing artists perform their songs up close an unforgettable experience.

Name: Little Rad Market
Description: Little Rad is one of my favorite spots to walk to for matcha or lunch with friends. It's cozy and cute and always a good place to sit and catch up during the day.

Name: Old Natchez Trace Road
Address: Old Natchez Trace Rd, Nashville, TN 37221
Description: Old Natchez Trace Road along the river is a spot we love to visit in the summer. There's a tire swing by the water that everyone jumps from, and it's one of those classic Nashville summer memories.

Name: Iroquois Steeplechase
Description: The Iroquois Steeplechase at Percy Warner Park is one of the biggest traditions in Nashville every spring. I love going with friends to watch the horse races and spend the day outside enjoying the event.

Name: Solidcore Green Hills
Description: Solidcore in Green Hills is my favorite workout spot in Nashville. The classes are challenging but fun, and it's a place that always makes me feel energized after a good workout.

Name: The Food Company
Description: The Food Company is one of my favorite restaurants during the day and turns into a fun bar scene at night. The space feels like a treehouse with tons of plants, which makes it a really unique and cool place to hang out.
